profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, trading on public markets under the ticker AMZN. The company's most recently reported annual revenue was $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025. AWS operates a broad cloud computing platform, and the pages harvested for this profile focus specifically on its machine learning and AI development offerings.

The primary product featured on the site is Amazon SageMaker, which AWS describes as a unified development environment for data, analytics, and machine learning. The site presents SageMaker Unified Studio as a single workspace that brings together model development tools including HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps capabilities, alongside generative AI application building, SQL analytics, and data processing. The platform is said to support lakehouse architecture spanning Amazon S3 data lakes and Amazon Redshift data warehouses using Apache Iceberg-compatible tooling, with federated query access to third-party data sources and near-real-time ingestion via zero-ETL integrations. Amazon Q Developer is positioned within the platform as an AI assistant for tasks such as data discovery, model building, SQL query generation, and pipeline creation through natural language. AWS also tracks a second product, AWS Bedrock, described as a managed foundation model API service with IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and an AgentCore component for agent orchestration.

The held facts indicate AWS carries legal exposure associated with Washington state, with 52 recorded cases in that jurisdiction. No MCP server registrations or patent filings are recorded in the current dataset beyond what is noted above.
